name: PPSI
old_description: Our AS9100D-certified facility, IPC-610 trained technicians, and four decades of manufacturing expertise mean your products are built to spec and shipped on time, so you can focus on what's next.
about:
PPSI has been assembling electronics in Houston, Texas since 1986. Founded as a small PCB assembly shop, the privately held company has grown into an AS9100D-certified manufacturing partner serving aerospace, defense, space, industrial, and energy customers. Four decades later, the fundamentals remain: build it right, deliver on time, and communicate honestly.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services from its Houston facility. Core capabilities include surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology PCB assembly with component placement down to 01005 packages; custom cable and wire harness assemblies built to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards; comprehensive testing and programming with AOI, X-ray, flying probe, and functional test; and full systems integration covering box build, electromechanical assembly, and conformal coating for harsh-environment and high-temperature deployments. Supply chain management services handle turnkey procurement, inventory, and fulfillment under a single quality system.

PPSI serves military and aerospace, space and satellite, industrial, and energy and oil-and-gas sectors. Customers include defense and aerospace programs requiring absolute precision, flight hardware and satellite components that must not fail, complex industrial control systems, and rugged electronics for downhole, pipeline, and refinery applications.

The company emphasizes stability from 40-plus years in business, AS9100D and IPC Class 3 quality controls, direct communication with the build team, flexibility in a high-mix environment, and a Houston location that supports site visits and audits. Its single-source model aims to reduce handoffs and accelerate time to market.
